content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) recommends four diagnostic tests for the identification of prediabetes and type 2 diabetes. Another option is the 2-hour plasma glucose (PG) test, conducted during an oral glucose tolerance test (OGTT), which evaluates the body’s ability to manage glucose after consuming a glucose-rich solution. Additionally, the A1C test, which reflects average blood glucose levels over the past two to three months, is also considered appropriate for screening purposes.
